meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入并解析已有小说为可续写目录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有已写好的小说，想纳入项目化写作流程继续创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import and parse existing novels into a structured, continuable project.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a finished or partial novel and want to bring it into a structured writing workflow.

howto.what: 将你已写好的小说（半成品或完本）按长篇/短篇自动分流，拆解成情节、角色、设定等分析资产，再重建为可续写的标准项目结构，包括大纲、正文、角色档案、伏笔/时间线追踪等，之后可直接用写作技能继续写。
howto.when: 当你说“导入小说”“反向解析”等，或输入 /story-import 时触发；也可直接提供小说文件或贴文本。

say.text: 导入小说，文件在 桌面/我的书.txt
say.note: Claude 会先确认书名和篇幅，再开始分析

say.text: 把我的书导进来，做成可续写的写作工程
say.note: Claude 会开始拆解并重建项目结构

say.text: 反向解析这本小说，按短篇处理
say.note: Claude 会按短篇管道拆解并迁移

howto.what_en: Converts a novel (partial or complete) into a writable project. Auto-routes by length, analyzes into plot/character/setting assets, then rebuilds them into outline, chapters, and trackers for direct continuation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'import a novel' or 'reverse-analyze', or use /story-import. You can also provide a file path or paste text.

say_en.text: Import a novel, the file is at Desktop/my_book.txt
say_en.note: Claude will confirm title and length, then start analysis.

say_en.text: Import my book and make it a continuable writing project.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm intent if unclear, then proceed.

say_en.text: Reverse-analyze this novel, treat it as a short story.
say_en.note: Claude will run the short-story pipeline and migrate.
